issues.finding: The action prompt supplied the perception route, planner, arm candidates, normal, distances, ordered stages, speed, arrival tolerance, and timeout. It also referred to earlier iterations. This run is a researcher-prescribed execution diagnostic, not an autonomous planning baseline.
issues.correction: Use one shared task-independent instruction and a task_id/goal-only task file. Save the prompt hash. Keep research history exclusively in supervisor artifacts.

issues.finding: The waypoint builder places the TCP origin at contact_point_world_m. The solver correctly transforms that TCP into the flange frame, but no parameter specifies a physical finger contact feature, its pose in the TCP frame, aperture-dependent offset, or contact patch. A narrow target can lie between open fingers. Discrete IK does not validate material contact.
issues.user_hypothesis: Press with one finger on the stapler upper surface instead of aligning the whole gripper center with it.
confirmed: No physical contact validation is performed
The latest run timed out at contact before formal press execution
unconfirmed: Which link, if any, touched or collided during the latest run
Whether finger gap, target localization, collision, or controller behavior caused the contact-stage stall
issues.next_geometry_requirement: Represent a calibrated physical contact feature and gripper state; map its desired world pose to TCP/flange pose, then separately check clearance and effect. Do not invent an offset or merely increase press depth.

comparison_note: The new prompt is not byte-comparable with the prescribed run. Tool warning changes must also be reported; do not attribute future gains to the model alone.
